# As-filed record, do not edit

The three documents in this folder are the text of the provisional patent
applications filed with the USPTO (per the founder, confirmed September 2026:
filed, pending examination). They are kept unchanged as the record of what was
actually submitted and when.

They are **superseded in substance**. The claims in them recite a planarian
substrate and absolute-voltage-level encoding, both of which this project's own
later simulations retired. `patents/PATENT_GAP_ANALYSIS_2026.md` lists every
disagreement between this text and the current science.

**Do not edit these files.** A filed application cannot be amended by editing a
markdown file. Changes reach the USPTO record only through a preliminary
amendment, a continuation or continuation-in-part, or a fresh application, and
that is the attorney's call. If these files are edited, the answer to "what did
we actually file" is lost, and that question will be asked during examination,
during any continuation, and during any investor diligence.

The current drafts live in `patents/drafts_2026/`.
